title: Create src/commands/init.ts handler
description: Implement the full init command handler. Calls createAgentStructure in the current directory. If .agent/ already exists, shows a warning and asks for confirmation.
acceptanceCriteria: rocket init creates the .agent/ structure in the current working directory
Success message lists all created files
Running rocket init when .agent/ already exists asks for confirmation before proceeding
User can cancel (answer 'n') without overwriting files

steps.details: Import createAgentStructure, fs, path. async function initCommand() { const agentDir = path.join(process.cwd(), '.agent'); if (await fs.pathExists(agentDir)) { // show warning and prompt } else { await createAgentStructure(process.cwd()); console.log('✅ .agent/ structure created') } }

Use readline to ask for confirmation: const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout }); const answer = await new Promise(resolve => rl.question('.agent/ already exists. Proceed? (y/N) ', resolve)); if (answer !== 'y') { console.log('Aborted.'); return } await createAgentStructure(process.cwd())

steps.description: Print success message with file list
steps.details: After creating: console.log('Created:'); console.log('  .agent/prd/PRD.md'); console.log('  .agent/prd/SUMMARY.md'); console.log('  .agent/logs/LOG.md'); console.log('  .agent/PROMPT.md'); console.log('  .agent/tasks.json')
